description: AI procurement due-diligence investigator: a Planner, three parallel Executors, an Adversarial Evaluator and a Writer build an evidence backed risk report with deterministic scoring and a Path to Greenlight remediation table.

cursor.integration: Development environment used for the scaffold and completion. Per the 2026-10-22 HackOS onboarding update, Cursor is optional and any AI coding tool is allowed; the code is tool agnostic and the README AI disclosure names the tools actually used.
cursor.load_bearing_proof: README AI disclosure section; the app itself does not depend on Cursor at runtime.

meterless.integration: Nightshift Meterless Runtime is the primary AI provider. cognition/generator.py is an OpenAI compatible client against METERLESS_BASE_URL with Bearer METERLESS_RUNTIME_TOKEN and headers meterless-app: receipts and meterless-scope: user. Every agent receives an injected generate_fn; every call logs latency, tokens, model and agent id to logs/traces.jsonl.
meterless.load_bearing_proof: Traces record model and route per call; in SAMPLE_MODE the mock provider is labeled sample-mock and never claims Nemotron; in LIVE mode the Runtime model string is logged exactly as returned.

nvidia.integration: NVIDIA Nemotron is reached ONLY through the Meterless Nightshift Runtime lane. No code in this repo calls NVIDIA directly, and no NVIDIA key appears in any file, setting, or environment template.
nvidia.load_bearing_proof: Default model string nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b; the value meterless/auto is never used because it may route to a non NVIDIA model; traces log the exact model string used.

zetaris.integration: Load-bearing financial data layer. data_layer/zetaris_client.py queries the Zetaris REST API at ZETARIS_REST_URL (port 8888, never the 3000 web UI) with Authorization Bearer, X-Org-ID and a fresh X-Request-ID per request, via POST /sql-editor/sqls/run.
zetaris.load_bearing_proof: In live mode a disabled or unreachable Zetaris raises ZetarisDataLayerUnavailableError from the financial executor and the pipeline stops loudly (see tests/test_receipts.py::test_zetaris_load_bearing). Traces and citations carry the Zetaris table and row locators.

track: Track 2: The Agent That Can Explain Why
